chapter_title: Concerning the Four Things over which People kill

fills.notes: This item introduces the 4-fold natural compulsions; “obsession” fits the impersonal, diagnostic register for the first drive (food/belly).
Eating is framed as serving bodily enlargement; “swelling” maintains the negative, corporeal correspondence (inflation of the outer).

fills.fill: and they will not be satisfied from it
fills.notes: The sequence needs the standard correspondential conclusion to appetite: continual craving without satiety. This also prepares ¶8 (“leave them behind and die”).
The second drive is coupling; the word-join demands “sexual inter-…course.”

fills.fill: and the defilement of the body
fills.notes: After naming intercourse, the substrate typically states its corporeal/spiritual effect: pollution/mixture; keeps non-moralizing, structural language.
A missing vice-term between “fornication … fornication” is best supplied by the complementary category “adultery,” matching the list-like cadence.
A general term is expected before “men and women … with each other,” indicating the impelling forces (lusts/affections) rather than exhortation.
The clause “men and women [...] in it with each other” requires a verb of mixing/commingling, a key correspondential term for disorderly union.
Wealth in the oldest layer is usually treated as grasping/accumulation; “hoarding” bridges to “useless riches.”
“pride themselves without … from it” calls for “without benefit/profit,” i.e., no real use (correspondence: riches without use are empty externals).
“the disputes, the … and the trials” fits a triad of conflict-forms; “judgments” (legal contests) pairs naturally with disputes and trials.
The sentence needs a connective to continue: people strive to generate these things “in the world … and in them/among them.” This keeps the impersonal observational tone.
They “struggle so that they might generate them … among them”: the generated products are the inner impulses that then become outer acts; “desires” matches the correspondential inside→outside logic.

The subject must be a cosmic separator who divides Light/Darkness. In the Iranian-Manichaean substrate this role belongs to the Living Spirit (organizing/separating power), stated without apostolic frame.

assessment: Most gaps can be restored at the level of correspondential function (four compulsions; insatiability; mixture/defilement; useless wealth; conflict triad; cosmic separator). Exact lexical choices for the smaller list-terms (¶3–¶6) remain somewhat underconstrained without additional manuscript traces, so several restorations are necessarily tentative but consistent with the oldest cosmological register and inside→outside logic.
